title: Community-Aligned Behavior Under Uncertainty: Evidence of Epistemic Stance Transfer in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Inducing epistemic uncertainty by unlearning specific factual event knowledge (using Scalar Attention Module Intervention) and evaluating whether models fall back on community-specific reasoning patterns and response strategies (epistemic frames) using Jensen-Shannon divergence.

Aligning models to Russian versus Ukrainian military blogger communities (via prompting or fine-tuning) and classifying the epistemic framing of their responses to wartime events like the Bucha massacre and Mariupol theater bombing.

Aligning models to U.S. conservative versus liberal Twitter communities and evaluating the epistemic framing of their responses regarding the Harris-Trump presidential debate under induced factual ignorance.
